messages:
Jules Park: Passing OrchID Payments (mid-market payments) to CS — closed today. Quick context: they want Private (VPC) + Okta SSO, Dedicated capacity (monthly commit). Main contacts: anita@orchidpay.com (product), leo@orchidpay.com (infra). Expected peak ~70 QPS, avg seq 220. SLA ask: p99 < 300ms. Renewal ~10mo. Legal flagged data residency + SOC2 evidence. Immediate asks: CSM, eng ticket for VPC peering & cert exchange, compliance enablement, initial success metrics. Risk: if pilot kickoff slips >3w exec momentum cools.

Nina Alvarez: I can take CSM. Thanks Jules. Can you share Anita's availability? Ill schedule kickoff for 30-45m and build the onboarding runbook. Need Okta admin contact for SAML metadata.

Jules Park: Anita = anita@orchidpay.com, Okta admin = leo@orchidpay.com. Pilot target = two weeks out. Contract signed; billing monthly. Legal loop started.

Samir Patel: Eng notes: will open infra ticket for VPC peering + TLS cert exchange. Need CIDR ranges, egress rules, and whether they require private egress via NAT. Also confirm model pinning vs routing policy — pinned quantized model needs 3-4d build. Tagging @Olivia for support handoff.

Olivia Hart: Support: Ill own the post-prod runbook. Items: escalation path (oncall rotation), log access (S3 or streaming), expected error modes, fallback model rules, prompt retention policy. Recommend a tabletop pilot incident in week 2.

Connor Lee: CS Ops: Ill prepare the success metrics template (latency, cost per 1k tokens, top-1 accuracy on eval prompts) and enablement packs for infra & compliance. Suggest weekly exec syncs Nina<>Anita for first 6 weeks.

Priya Rao: Legal: weve queued the DPA + SOC2 artifact pull. ETA to compile is ~4 business days. Please flag any changes that expand data flows.

OnboardBot: CHECKLIST CREATED — Kickoff requested (wk of 1795006840), Okta metadata requested, VPC peering form submitted, Dedicated capacity pre-reserved, SOC2 artifact request logged. Link: https://internal.redwood/orchidpay/onboarding

Nina Alvarez: Recap owners & next steps:
- Nina Alvarez: CSM, schedule kickoff, onboarding runbook, weekly exec syncs
- Samir Patel: open eng ticket (VPC peering, cert exchange), confirm CIDRs & egress, model pin/build estimate
- Olivia Hart: support runbook + pilot incident drill
- Connor Lee: success metrics deck + enablement materials
- Priya Rao: deliver SOC2 artifacts & DPA status
- Jules Park: confirm any customer constraints and introduce Anita in kickoff thread
Ill create a shared doc and ping owners on blocked items. :thumbsup:
